cn_title: 索尼称停售PlayStation光盘不会冲击业务
subtitle: 实体争议未歇
opus_summary: 索尼称，计划2028年终止PlayStation光盘生产的决定目前未影响业务，未来也预计不会产生负面影响。其表示内容销售大部分已数字化，但会考虑玩家对实体介质的情感与反馈。

paragraphs.en: Sony’s controversial decision to discontinue PlayStation discs is not having any impact on its business now, and it doesn’t see any negative impact in the future, either.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼终止PlayStation光盘生产的争议决定，当前未对业务产生影响；它也不认为未来会有负面影响。

paragraphs.en: Speaking during an investor-focused Q&A following its first quarter financial results, Sony CFO Lin Tao answered multiple questions about the company’s decision to kill discs, which has sparked a backlash online.
paragraphs.cn: 在第一季度财报后的面向投资者问答中，索尼首席财务官Lin Tao回答了多个有关公司停售光盘决定的问题，这一决定已在网上引发反弹。

paragraphs.en: Tao was asked if Sony saw any impact now or in the future, which will see PlayStation disc production come to an end in 2028.
paragraphs.cn: Tao被问到索尼是否看到当下或未来的任何影响；该决定将使PlayStation光盘生产在2028年结束。

paragraphs.en: “We are not seeing any impact on our business as of now,” Tao said. “Going forward, about the content sales, large part is already digitized. Therefore as a result of the discontinuation of a disc, we don’t see that there will be any negative impact on our business.
paragraphs.cn: Tao说：「截至目前，我们没有看到这会对业务造成任何影响。展望未来，内容销售方面大部分内容已经数字化。因此，停售光盘不会对我们的业务带来负面影响。」

paragraphs.en: “However, as I already said, the users, the players, have attachments, and we have to think about how to respond to those feedbacks.”
paragraphs.cn: 「不过，正如我先前所说，用户、玩家对实体光盘有情感依附，我们必须考虑如何回应这些反馈。」

paragraphs.en: Earlier in the Q&A, Tao said Sony wouldn’t change its mind , while acknowledging “strong views” from the video game community.
paragraphs.cn: 在问答早些时候，Tao表示索尼不会改变主意，同时承认游戏社区有「强烈看法」。

paragraphs.en: The online backlash has seen gamers continue to call on Sony to U-turn on its decision, signing online petitions and swarming over PlayStation social media posts to express concern about video game preservation and ownership — even overshadowing the release of new games that have nothing to do with what’s going on at Sony. Meanwhile, backers of physical media have called on gamers to boycott PlayStation for a week in August to send a message to Sony that its decision to kill discs from 2028 is unacceptable.
paragraphs.cn: 网络反弹使玩家继续敦促索尼撤销决定：他们签署在线请愿书，并涌入PlayStation社交媒体帖文表达对游戏保存和所有权的担忧——甚至盖过了与索尼当前事件无关的新游戏发售。与此同时，实体媒介支持者呼吁玩家在8月抵制PlayStation一周，以向索尼传达：其自2028年起停售光盘的决定不可接受。

paragraphs.en: Complaints have also come from other groups. The UK’s Digital Entertainment and Retail Association (ERA), for example, called Sony’s decision “a triumph of corporate convenience over consumer choice.”
paragraphs.cn: 其他团体也提出了批评。例如，英国Digital Entertainment and Retail Association（ERA）称索尼的决定是「企业便利压倒消费者选择的胜利」。

paragraphs.en: When Sony announced its decision it said it was simply following consumer trends. “In response to shifting trends in consumer preference, new games will be released on PlayStation Store and at retailers in digital formats only,” Sid Shuman, Senior Director, Sony Interactive Entertainment Content Communications, said in a post on PlayStation Blog .
paragraphs.cn: 索尼宣布决定时称，这只是顺应消费者趋势。索尼互动娱乐内容传播高级总监Sid Shuman在PlayStation Blog的一篇帖子中表示：「为顺应消费者偏好的变化，新游戏将仅以数字格式在PlayStation Store和零售商渠道发行。」

paragraphs.en: Sony's latest financials show an 82% digital download ratio for full game software across PS4 and PS5. Reinforcing this trend, Mat Piscatella, Senior Director and Video Game Industry Advisor at Circana, recently said that just seven PlayStation video games had sold more than 100,000 physical units so far this year in the U.S. . Only two PlayStation video games sold more than 10,000 physical units in the U.S. during the week ending July 11.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼最新财报显示，PS4和PS5全游戏软件的数字下载比例为82%。进一步印证这一趋势的是，Circana高级总监兼电子游戏行业顾问Mat Piscatella近日表示，截至今年目前，美国市场仅有7款PlayStation游戏的实体销量超过100,000份。截至7月11日当周，美国市场只有2款PlayStation游戏的实体销量超过10,000份。

paragraphs.en: There are of course instances of companies reversing controversial decisions amid a backlash, but, as analysts have told IGN , it remains unlikely that Sony will U-turn on this. For Sony, going all-digital for new game releases will earn it more money from every sale at a time when console sales are expected to plummet due to their rising cost. For a first-party PlayStation game such as The Last of Us, Sony will only keep around 65% of the money from a physical copy, with around 30% going to the retailer and roughly another 5% on manufacturing costs. Meanwhile, for a physical copy of a third-party game such as the Activision-published Call of Duty, Sony will get a licensing fee, likely around 15%.
paragraphs.cn: 企业在反弹下撤销争议决定的先例当然并非没有，但正如分析人士告诉IGN的那样，索尼仍不太可能在这件事上掉头。对索尼而言，新游戏全面数字化能令它从每笔销售中获得更多收入，彼时主机销量预计会因价格上涨而大跌。以《最后生还者》等PlayStation第一方游戏为例，索尼从实体版收入中只能保留约65%，其中约30%归零售商，约5%为制造成本。与此同时，对于Activision发行的《使命召唤》等第三方游戏实体版，索尼将获得许可费，可能约为15%。

paragraphs.en: For downloads, however, the margins are much higher. For a first-party game sold via Sony's own PlayStation Store, the company obviously keeps 100% of the revenue. For third-party games such as Call of Duty, meanwhile, Sony keeps a 30% cut (so, roughly $21 for a $70 game).
paragraphs.cn: 数字下载的利润率则高得多。第一方游戏通过索尼自有的PlayStation Store销售时，公司显然能保留100%的收入；对于《使命召唤》等第三方游戏，索尼可抽成30%，也就是一款70美元(约合人民币475元)的游戏能为其带来约21美元(约合人民币143元)的收入。
